name: Progress-40
about: Progress-40 (1989-008A), a crewed vehicle (Progress), launched 1989 Feb 10. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1989 Feb 17), held fixed
docked to S17845; it stays docked here until its end of mission (GCAT psatcat TDate), when it burns up; the undocking and deorbit burn are folded into that (a fudge of up to a few days)
GCAT gives the end of mission (psatcat TDate) without an hour

events.why: GCAT gives the end of mission without an hour
